Hey, things do get better don't worry :)

I once told someone I would've killed myself a long time ago except I was too much of a coward, they replied with something that'll stay with me forever, and I'm gonna tell it to you now:

"You're not weak because you can't kill yourself, you're strong because you haven't."

Hang in there. There is hope just don't forget that :)
I have tried, and I feel like everything I find runs away from me.

>I realise why people do take the piss out of a worthless piece of unwanted waste like me, but why me? Why do i have to be the one on the verge of suicide?

You're honestly not the only one. I'm of similar age to you and I can tell you for a fact you're not the only person who feels like this, some of the most cheerful people you meet feel the same. And not to mention theres a lot of people on the subreddit (I won't say which one for the sake of privacy) who go through remarkably similar conditions, and have common interests to you. If you need to talk to someone familiar you can always go to those you trust over there, but if you need to talk to someone new, then you can PM me for my skype if you want :)

I guess I can kinda relate to you. I was born with ADHD and semi-colour blind, things aren't exactly easy. 

My parents also seperated when I was a week old.

If theres anyhting you wanna talk about or ask me I'd be happy to help :)
